name: ai-supply-index
title: AI Supply Index — who is actually earning in the AI economy?
description: A weekly, timestamped, independently collected record of the supply side of the AI economy. Each publication is OpenTimestamps-stamped: the series is copied to a frozen, dated snapshot under archive/ and that snapshot is stamped next to it, so that "we measured this on that date" is verifiable, not asserted.
